meta.title: Remote Enhanced
meta.description: Show local and remote folders side by side in the native DSH workspace list, with the remote computer name appended. Open sessions directly and retain separate drafts without changing the global Remote target or reloading the page. Targets DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 and Remote 0.6.5.

ui.loadFailed: Could not load remote workspaces. Click to retry.
ui.partialFailed: Some remote workspaces could not load. Click to retry.
ui.hostOffline: This computer is offline. Open it after it reconnects.
ui.openFailed: Could not open the session. Check the Remote connection and retry.
ui.sessionUnavailable: This session is unavailable. Refresh the workspaces and retry.
ui.independentRoutingRequired: Global-target selection has been retired. Open the session directly from its workspace.
ui.fileUnavailable: Remote file unavailable. Check the computer connection, path and read permissions.
ui.directoryTruncated: This folder reached the display limit.
ui.remoteApplication: Preview remote files or download them to this computer first.
ui.previewPortDenied: {computer} has not allowed webpage port {port}. Allow this port in the signed-in DSH Remote settings on that computer, save, then refresh this page here.
ui.previewServiceUnavailable: The webpage service on {computer} did not respond on port {port}. Start that service on that computer, then refresh this page here.
ui.mapFilesHint: Click a map file, then preview or download it here. Toggling reloads this page.
ui.mapFilesOffHint: Enable local preview first. Original page actions run on the remote computer; toggling reloads this page.
ui.checkHint: Check this installation and the authorized computer list, then check each connection on demand. No messages or commands are executed.
ui.checkFailed: The check did not finish. Check this computer's DSH connection and refresh.
ui.checkVersionHint: Requires {expected}. Check the version in Plugins.
ui.checkTerminalHint: Check the terminal switch and Harness terminal support in Remote settings on this computer.
ui.checkChildStopHint: Enable the same enhanced bundle on the remote computer. Open one of its sessions and check again to confirm the Stop command.
ui.checkNotProbed: Not connected for this check. Use this computer's check button.
ui.connectionRateLimited: Remote is rate limited. Wait before retrying; avoid repeated connection clicks.
ui.connectionServiceUnavailable: Remote service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later and keep the existing login and device authorization.
ui.connectionHostOffline: Open DSH on that computer and confirm Remote is online, then retry.
ui.connectionConnectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check both networks and the remote DSH status, then retry.
ui.connectionAuthorizationRequired: Check login and device authorization in the original Remote panel, then retry.
ui.connectionConnectionInterrupted: Connection interrupted; recovery is in progress. Submitted operations are never replayed automatically.
ui.connectionConnectionFailed: Check Remote status and the network on both computers, then retry.
